# Kyoto Review of Southeast Asia

> > A multilingual academic journal published by Kyoto University examining regional politics, security challenges, and contemporary issues across Southeast Asia.

Kyoto Review of Southeast Asia is a peer-reviewed journal dedicated to publishing research and analysis on Southeast Asian affairs. The publication features expert commentary, policy analysis, and multimedia content covering topics from Myanmar's political crisis to transnational security threats, with content available in English and multiple Southeast Asian languages.

## Key Topics

- Myanmar security challenges
- ASEAN diplomacy
- Southeast Asia regional politics
- Non-traditional security
- Post-2021 coup
- Cybercrime and scams
- Humanitarian crisis
- Political instability
- Climate change impacts
- Regional analysis
- ASEAN Five-Point Consensus
- Academic research
- Policy analysis
- Kyoto University
- Southeast Asia studies

## Current Issue & Featured Articles

- [Non-traditional security challenges in Southeast Asia](https://kyotoreview.org/issue-42-mar-2026/non-traditional-security-challenges-in-southeast-asia): Issue 42 overview examining climate change, scams, terrorism in SE Asia
- [The Challenges of Addressing Myanmar's Post-2021 Security Challenges](https://kyotoreview.org/issue-42-mar-2026/myanmars-post-2021-security-challenges): Analysis of Myanmar security challenges post-2021 coup and ASEAN response
- [Thailand's Anti-scam Efforts are well Behind the Pace of Criminality](https://kyotoreview.org/issue-42-mar-2026/thailands-anti-scam-efforts-are-well-behind-the-pace-of-criminality): Analysis of Thailand's cybercrime and online scam challenges
